## Pass 3 design-source posture

Beautiful UI, beUI, Rare UI, Transitions.dev, and shadcn/ui are inventoried in:

`reports/glp-clinic-scout/rebuild/pass3/ANIMATION-LIBRARY-INVENTORY.md`

The Pass 3 implementation defaults to clean native HTML/CSS/JavaScript adaptations rather than vendoring those React libraries. If substantial third-party source is later copied into the candidate, its required copyright and license notice must be added here before acceptance.
